theme: Dynamic Astral Hazards & Kinetic Gravity Resonance

deliverables_in_scope.title: Astra-Singularity Dynamic Core: An interactive graviton node that manifests at sector intersections, physically pulsing gravitational wave rings outward to magnetically pull cursor reticles and bend inscribed particle beams toward its epicenter.

Kinetic Overcharge Sigil Strike: Active placement mechanic where timing an inscription input with the lattice's inward breathing pulse supercharges the sigil, emitting a directional shockwave that displaces adjacent ambient energy embers and fractures neighboring partition borders.

Diegetic Lattice Stress Fractures & Radiant Crucible Bloom: Pure in-world visual feedback system replacing external state prompts with progressive glowing obsidian fractures, dynamic refractive ripples along partition lines, and prismatic heat distortion over contested triad corridors.
